concepts.title: Inheritance
concepts.description: Inheritance lets a class reuse and extend behavior from a parent class.
concepts.content: Inheritance creates a relationship between classes so shared behavior can live in one place. A child class can use parent methods and optionally override them with more specific behavior.

concepts.title: Abstraction
concepts.description: Abstraction hides internal complexity and exposes a simple interface to use.
concepts.content: Abstraction helps developers focus on what a system does instead of how every internal step works. A clean public API keeps code easier to use, maintain, and test.
